name: create_google_doc
description: Create a new Google Doc with a title. Returns the document ID and web link. Use this to start a new document.

name: read_google_doc
description: Read the entire content of a Google Doc as plain text. Use this to retrieve document content.

document_id.description: The Google Doc ID to read

name: insert_text_google_doc
description: Insert text at a specific position in a Google Doc. Position 1 is the start of the document. Use this to add content to a document.

index_pos.description: Position to insert at (1 = start of document)

name: delete_content_google_doc
description: Delete content from a Google Doc between start and end positions. Use this to remove text from a document.

start_index.description: Start position of content to delete

end_index.description: End position of content to delete

name: replace_all_text_google_doc
description: Find and replace all occurrences of text in a Google Doc. Use this to update specific text throughout the document.
